name: unchecked-parse
title: Reject trailing junk after numeric parses
lesson: A parse that consumes only the prefix of an input has not validated the whole input.
fix_goal: Require the whole input to parse cleanly and be in range.
fix_steps: Use a checked conversion that reports where parsing stopped.
Reject empty input, range errors, and trailing non-whitespace junk.
Re-run the lab and confirm trailing junk is not accepted.
